about: The Library's doors to print, one record (scripts/inject_support.py reads it; the scraping-amazon-affiliate-link skill writes it). books: Amazon affiliate boxes, each a SiteStripe link (asin + linkId, tag lerinspress-20). doors: boxes to the press's recommendation shelves. shelves: each Library shelf's catch-all (a book, a door, or "lerins:<slug>" for our own edition on sale) (its overview and every work without its own). works: a page's own book or door, {lerins: slug} for our own edition's card, {miss: why, date} for a search that found no good edition, {hand: why} for a page that carries a box written by hand.

summa-dominican-5vol.words: Would you like the Summa in print? The English Dominican translation read here comes as a five-volume hardcover set.
summa-dominican-5vol.label: Buy on Amazon (Hardcover, 5 volumes)

city-of-god-bettenson.words: Would you like Augustine in print? The City of God, in Henry Bettenson’s translation, is in paperback from Penguin Classics.

calvin-institutes-hendrickson.words: Would you like the Institutes in print? Henry Beveridge’s translation, the one read here, is in one hardcover volume from Hendrickson.
